literal: When he does not come, they do not sleep; if he comes, they do not sleep; in both states, intense grief have experienced the eyes.
translation: When my lover does not come, my eyes do not sleep; even when he does come, they do not sleep. In either state, they suffer endless grief.
modern: காதலர் வராதபோது கண்கள் தூங்குவதில்லை; அவர் வந்தபோதும் அவை தூங்குவதில்லை; இவ்விரண்டு நிலைகளிலும் என் கண்கள் மிகுந்த துன்பத்தையே அடைகின்றன.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine laments the constant distress of her eyes. When her lover is away, her eyes cannot sleep because of the painful longing of separation. When he returns, they still do not sleep because they fear losing sight of him even for a moment, or because they are too busy gazing at him. Thus, whether he is absent or present, her eyes find no rest and suffer continuous affliction.
